name: Soon
source:
That Dr Fang thinks she's so special just because she solved global warming and never blew up any of Switzerland. But now you have a time machine and soon, soon they will ALL PAY.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=24221]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
方博士认为她如此特别只是因为她解决了全球变暖问题并且从未炸毁过瑞士的任何一个地方。但现在你有了一台时间机器，很快，很快他们都会付出代价。

[来自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=24221]引理软论坛[/url]]
